# godotwright-gameoptimizer

> Performance optimizer for Godot 4 games, built for coding agents. An MCP server and CLI by laaielichter that audit
> a project from its files, predict rendering cost across an open world, apply reversible fixes and prove each one
> with benchmarks and screenshot comparison. Node 20+, zero dependencies, MIT.

Start: `npx -y github:laaielichter/godotwright-gameoptimizer mcp` (MCP over stdio) or
`npx -y github:laaielichter/godotwright-gameoptimizer audit <project>`.

## Tools

- optimizer_audit: findings with evidence and a plan of fixes. No Godot needed.
- optimizer_costmap: predicted triangles and draw calls per world cell, hotspots, a benchmark route.
- optimizer_textures: GPU memory per texture.
- optimizer_fix: install | settings | textures | lods | lights | ranges | instancing | partition. dry_run supported.
- optimizer_undo: take a fix back; every fix is journaled.
- optimizer_bench: run the game in Godot, measure frame times, hitches, draw calls, memory, screenshots.
- optimizer_compare: before and after, per metric and per screenshot, with a verdict.
- optimizer_import: import assets, also on machines without a GPU.
- optimizer_explain: why a finding costs performance and how the fix works.
- optimizer_demo: write a heavy open-world demo project.
